title: Voices from the Grave (BBC Radio)
paragraphs: A BBC series of four intimate supernatural dramas inspired by ghost stories from around Britain, using hauntings to explore grief, love, anger, longing, and other human emotions.
Four intimate supernatural dramas inspired by British ghost stories/legends. Conflict is preserved explicitly.
The run breaks into several distinct periods: Frozen March 2006 sequence (March 7, 2006 to March 10, 2006) on [[org|org.deepv2.f713a484394d0d32|BBC Radio]].

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include Gemma Jenkins (producer), Geoffrey Beevers (performer), Luke Fresle (producer), Christian Patterson (performer), David Varela (writer), Dylan Ritson (writer), and Elizabeth Morgan (performer).

The stories often return to haunted places and supernatural encounter, grief love rage longing and pain, Victorian London haunted-house tradition, Welsh village curse and folk belief, psychiatric hospital and institutional decay, and faith, missionary return and biblical horror.
The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes Frozen March 2006 Voices from the Grave chronology and Voices from the Grave network/date metadata conflict.
